email.subject1: a signal play for PTO Exchange
email.body1:
Stephanie, saw PTO Exchange passed 3M hours exchanged, launched PTO Early Access, and added Paycor and Aptia as partners.

That kind of momentum usually opens more employer accounts in your East territory than a team can cover, and that coverage gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PTO Exchange off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stephanie, quick follow-up for PTO Exchange.

A territory quota lives or dies on consistent meetings, but most teams don't know exactly how many they need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and then the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the East needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stephanie, last bit of proof for PTO Exchange.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PTO Exchange's reply rate likely compares to other benefits-tech sales teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Stephanie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling territory pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know new partnerships and a product launch keep a sales director fully booked.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your East territory? I'll tailor it to PTO Exchange either way.
